The percentage decline is calculated as:

$$
\text{Percentage Decline} = \left( \frac{\text{Initial Rate} - \text{Final Rate}}{\text{Initial Rate}} \right) \times 100
$$

$$
= \left( \frac{820 - 697}{820} \right) \times 100 = \left( \frac{123}{820} \right) \times 100 \approx 15.0\%
$$

The percentage decline relative to the initial rate is **15.0%**.
